描述_EN: bottle of porcelain, painted in colours on a black ground with four medallions, each containing a representation of a buddhist deity (tephanon). mounted with copper round the base rim. the black ground is covered in conventional cloud forms. the bands around the foot and lower part of the neck are filled in with diaper and floral devices.
描述_ZN: 瓷瓶，黑底彩绘，有四个奖章，每个奖章都有一个佛教神像（Tephanon）。 底部边缘镶有铜片。 黑地上布满了传统的云形。 足部和颈部下部的带子上填有尿布和花纹。
